commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The corner from Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) is cleared away by the defence.
90+5' Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
90+3' Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
90+1' Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) sees his long-range effort blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The manager makes a subsitution with Samir El Mourabet (Morocco) coming on for Azzedine Ounahi.
89' Steve Clarke decides to make a substitution. John McGinn will be replaced by Ross Stewart (Scotland).
89' Substitution. Nathan Patterson will be replaced by Anthony Ralston (Scotland).
88' Scott McTominay (Scotland) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the roof of the net. Bono is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
87' John McGinn (Scotland) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
86' Lyndon Dykes (Scotland) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
86' John McGinn (Scotland) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

85' Scott McTominay (Scotland) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Scotland have been awarded a corner kick.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Brahim Diaz as he is replaced by Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco).
84' Mohamed Ouahbi has decided to make a change. Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) for Ismael Saibari.
82' One of the Scotland players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
79' The attendance is 64146.
77' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) commits a rough challenge and Ilgiz Tantashev blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) was too forceful with his tackle and Ilgiz Tantashev interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
72' The game is interrupted. Scott McTominay (Scotland) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
71' Steve Clarke has decided to substitute Ryan Christie and he is replaced by Kenny McLean (Scotland).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lyndon Dykes (Scotland) will replace Che Adams.
68' The referee blows for a cooling break.
65' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
64' What a chance that is! Ryan Christie (Scotland) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
62' Excellent touch by Achraf Hakimi (Morocco)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
62' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
62' Referee Ilgiz Tantashev sees the trip by Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
60' Kieran Tierney (Scotland) is substituted due to injury. Steve Clarke gives a chance to Ben Gannon-Doak.
58' Kieran Tierney (Scotland) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
58' He should have scored! Brahim Diaz (Morocco) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
55' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) makes a rough challenge and Ilgiz Tantashev blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
51' The ball goes behind for a corner. Morocco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

51' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Morocco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

51' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) accepts a pass deep inside the box and after a nice touch sends the ball towards the top left corner. It is a pretty sweet shot, but one of the defenders changes the trajectory of the ball and deflects it onto the post. What an unlucky moment for Ismael Saibari (Morocco). He must have smashed a mirror recently. The linesman points to the corner flag, Morocco are going to take it.
50' The Scotland players can’t believe it after referee Ilgiz Tantashev signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
49' There's a break in play and referee Ilgiz Tantashev must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Scotland using VAR. This could be interesting!
49' PENALTY APPEAL by Scotland, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
47' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Referee Ilgiz Tantashev signals NO PENALTY for Scotland after a VAR review!

45+2' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Scotland.
45+2' Kieran Tierney (Scotland) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45+1' John McGinn (Scotland) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

44' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
43' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Scotland have a free kick.
42' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco).
41' The total number of attempts is 0:5.
40' Grant Hanley (Scotland) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
38' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ilgiz Tantashev no option but to blow his whistle.
37' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) is able to continue to play.
36' Looks like Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
36' What a big chance! Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
34' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
31' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
30' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
24' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Ilgiz Tantashev blows for a foul after Kieran Tierney (Scotland) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Issa Diop (Morocco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
21' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
20' A dangerous looking corner kick from Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is cleared to safety by the defence.
20' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Morocco win a corner.
18' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) swings it in and Achraf Hakimi gets on the end of it, but Angus Gunn shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
16' Ilgiz Tantashev blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) brought his opponent down.
15' 21:79 – the latest ball possession ratio.
12' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
11' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play and Morocco manage to earn a corner.
10' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Scotland.
6' Morocco are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
3' Ilgiz Tantashev blows his whistle for a foul after Kieran Tierney (Scotland) hacks down one of his opponents.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Brahim Diaz sets up Ismael Saibari (Morocco) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the roof of the net. 0:1.
